unit: tok/s aggregate, midpoint of a 2000-3000 vendor range
methodology: VENDOR RANGE, not a point measurement. Furiosa Hot Chips 2024 press release (2024-08-26): a single RNGD PCIe card delivers 2,000 to 3,000 tokens per second throughput for models around 10 billion parameters, depending on context length. Stored value is the midpoint. Engine version, batch size, quantization, and prompt and output lengths are not stated. Recorded as aggregate throughput: the sentence says throughput, and 2000-3000 tok/s on a 10B-class model is not a batch-1 decode rate. Early silicon, before the 2025 furiosa-llm stack.
notes: ENGINE_ID NOTE: pinned to vllm, the closest existing engine. Later Furiosa-LLM is described as vLLM-compatible; this 2024 press release does not name an engine.
